_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — BGO ring at 2 radiation lengths, v2 CRYOSTAT variant: r_inner = the CsI ring + 5 cm (BGO sits inside a cryostat; the crystals move 5 cm outward to make room for the cryostat + insulation). crysp_ring_1m: CsI r_inner 38.7 cm -> BGO r_inner 43.7 cm; n_phi recomputed at the fixed block face (~5.07 cm arc): 48 -> 54; n_z and AFOV unchanged (half_length 51.2 cm, ~1 m). wall = 2 X0 of BGO (X0 = 1.118 cm -> 2.236 cm). The config's [transport].crystal_material picks the crystal (BGO_195K produced); the geometry is shared across BGO temperatures. The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
